newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Sept 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Sept 17.

text.p: Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications to continue urging member countries of the International Telecommunications Union (ITU) to adopt an international standard for wireless traffic information and control.

Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto to visit Okinawa on Tuesday with a high-powered team of economic ministers to underscore central government's commitment to easing burden of U.S. bases and promoting economic development.
Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto to meet heads of Social Democratic Party and New Party Sakigake on Thursday to inform them of his plans for general election.

Yukio Hatoyama, former secretary-general of New Party Sakigake, Health and Welfare Minister Naoto Kan, and at least 40 House of Representatives members to form organising committee for the new Democratic Party.
